meta.kdst_note: Kickers and team defenses price from FantasyPros season projections only (no ESPN season projections exist for kickers or defensive stats — the ESPN intake covers QB/RB/WR/TE). Scoring-invariant: one number serves standard/half/full. K ROS = projected full-season FG/XP minus nflverse YTD actuals; DST ROS = per-game projection rates x games remaining (brackets are per-game). Prorated approximations (no YTD row): Charlie Smyth, Wil Lutz, Blake Grupe, Harrison Butker.
meta.actuals_note: YTD actuals subtracted from the ECR leg only (288 players with banked stats). The ESPN intake is already rest-of-season — no actuals subtraction on the ESPN leg. Actuals exclude INTs/fumbles by design (scoring_note).
meta.scoring_note: No INT/fumble data in season sources; values exclude them.
meta.ppg_note: Per-game points = ROS fantasy points / team games remaining (final games excluded).
meta.espn_note: espn_ros/espn_ppg = pure ESPN read over priced components only (espn_covered lists them; never zero-filled). espn_filled_ros/espn_filled_ppg = ESPN where priced, ECR fills the rest (ESPN takes precedence, no averaging); delta_espn_ecr(_ppg) is filled minus full ECR.
meta.pm_note: pm_ros/pm_ppg = pure prediction-markets read over priced components only (pm_covered lists them; never zero-filled). pm_filled_ros/pm_filled_ppg = prediction markets where priced, ECR fills the rest (PM takes precedence, no averaging); delta_pm_ecr(_ppg) is filled minus full ECR. Source: raw Kalshi/Polymarket season ladders (own isotonic math, local liquidity gate) — crowd wisdom, NOT sportsbook money. Season receptions ladders have no liquid two-sided market, so pass-catchers' pure reads exclude reception points by construction; complete reads (all NEED components priced) are a minority — see pm_complete/pm_covered.
meta.method_note: Primary trade value (blend_ros/blend_ppg): since 2026-09-16 the primary value IS the ECR leg — expert stat projections translated to fantasy points with banked actuals removed (rest-of-season). ESPN does not enter the primary value; it lives only in the comparison columns (espn_ros / espn_filled_ros: ESPN where priced, ECR fills the rest, no averaging). No cross-source level translation in the primary value: ecr_share = 1.0 and pricing = 'experts_only' for every player. The chart engine then applies the legacy model value-above-waivers methodology to every source identically: positional waiver lines, smoothed starter/bench lineup weights, 70-point scale pinned to the frozen ECR baseline.
meta.disagree_baseline_note: Empirical ESPN-vs-ECR direction, measured as mean(ecr_ppg - espn_filled_ppg) over espn_complete players (full-PPR /g: QB -0.98 (ESPN warmer), RB -0.63 (ESPN warmer), WR -0.01 (level), TE +0.2 (ESPN cooler)). Positive shade = ESPN cooler than ECR; negative = ESPN warmer. delta_espn_ecr_demeaned subtracts the player's positional baseline, and espn_adj_ppg translates ESPN points onto the experts' level, so the disagreement section's rank gaps are genuine ordering differences, not shade.
